analytics.name: Analytic 1769
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Data Destruction from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Command Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: pm uninstall OR rm -f called by process NOT IN $MDMAgentPackageList$ for package_count > $BulkUninstallThreshold$ within $DestructionWindow$ — command-line destruction activity]; File Deletion via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: unlink() or rmdir() on path IN /data/data/ OR /data/user/ OR /sdcard/ by process NOT IN $MDMAgentPackageList$ at rate > $DeletionRateThreshold$ within $DestructionWindow$]; Process Creation via Application Vetting / Managed Device Telemetry [sh or cmd process spawned with arguments containing 'pm uninstall' or 'rm' by parent NOT IN $MDMAgentPackageList$ — shell invocation for destruction commands]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Default 100 file deletions within window. Derive from MDM-managed wipe baseline.
Default 5 packages within window. MDM wipe uses different API.
